newsitem.title: USA: Gilbert sees Q4 EPS at $0.47-$0.51-share.
newsitem.headline: Gilbert sees Q4 EPS at $0.47-$0.51-share.

text.p: Gilbert Associates Inc said it expects to report fourth-quarter earnings in the range of $2.9 million to $3.2 million, or between $0.47 and $0.51 per share.

The company said the earnings exclude a charge of $10.3 million, or $1.63 per share, for the write-off of in-process research and development related to its SAFCO acquisition or a reverse reversal of about $1.0 million related to its 1995 UESC write-off.
The company earned $1.3 million, or $0.18 per share, in the year-earlier period, excluding charges.
